title: Anticipatory Bail
name: Anticipatory Bail (Section 482 BNSS)
desc: Protection before arrest when you fear arrest in an FIR or complaint. Applications under Section 482 BNSS (old Section 438 CrPC) before the Pune Sessions Court and the Bombay High Court, including interim protection until the final hearing. Shivajinagar, Pune. English, Hindi and Marathi.

title: Bail After Arrest
name: Bail After Arrest (Sections 480, 483 BNSS)
desc: Regular bail for a person in police or judicial custody. Bail applications before the Magistrate under Section 480 BNSS (old 437 CrPC), and before the Sessions Court and Bombay High Court under Section 483 BNSS (old 439 CrPC), including bail after rejection.

title: Interim Bail
name: Interim Bail
desc: Temporary bail while the main bail application is pending, or for a specific need such as medical treatment or a family emergency. Applications and extensions before the court hearing the main matter in Pune or at the Bombay High Court.

title: Default Bail
name: Default Bail (Section 187 BNSS)
desc: Release on bail when the police do not file the charge-sheet within 60 or 90 days, under Section 187(3) BNSS (old 167(2) CrPC). It must be claimed before the charge-sheet is filed. Also release of undertrial prisoners under Section 479 BNSS.

title: FIR Quashing
name: FIR Quashing at Bombay High Court (Section 528 BNSS)
desc: Petitions to quash an FIR or criminal case before the Bombay High Court under Section 528 BNSS (old Section 482 CrPC) and Article 226, including quashing after a genuine settlement and stay of investigation where the court allows it.

title: Bombay High Court
name: Bombay High Court Criminal Matters
desc: Criminal matters from Pune heard at the Bombay High Court in Mumbai: bail and anticipatory bail after the Sessions Court, FIR quashing, criminal appeals and revisions, suspension of sentence and writ petitions.

title: Pune District & Sessions Court
name: Pune District and Sessions Court Cases
desc: Criminal cases at the Pune District and Sessions Court, Shivajinagar: remand hearings, bail and anticipatory bail, discharge applications, Sessions and Magistrate trials, cross-examination of witnesses and final arguments.

title: Arrest & Police Custody
name: Arrest, Police Custody and Remand
desc: When a family member is arrested: the arrested person must be produced before a Magistrate within 24 hours (Section 58 BNSS). Help at the first remand hearing, opposing police custody where possible, and bail after arrest.

title: Police Notice & Station Visit
name: Police Notice and Police Station Visit (Section 35 BNSS)
desc: Advice before you answer a police notice or an enquiry call under Section 35(3) BNSS (old 41A CrPC), what to carry to the police station, how to give a statement, and anticipatory bail where arrest is feared.

title: Jail Visit & Release
name: Jail Visit (Yerwada) and Release After Bail
desc: Meeting an accused in Yerwada Central Jail, Pune, and the steps for release after a bail order: bail bonds, surety documents and the release order to the jail.

title: Urgent Criminal Legal Help
name: Urgent Criminal Legal Help in Pune
desc: Urgent help when there is an arrest, a fresh FIR or a police notice in Pune or Pimpri-Chinchwad: the first steps, the court involved and whether bail, anticipatory bail or quashing is the right route. Speak directly with Advocate Akash R. Chikate.

title: Criminal Legal Consultation
name: Criminal Law Consultation
desc: A consultation on your criminal matter at the Shivajinagar office or by phone: reading the FIR or notice, the sections involved, the court, the options and the documents to collect. In English, Hindi or Marathi.

title: POCSO Case Defence
name: POCSO Case Defence
desc: Defence of the accused in POCSO Act cases before the Special Court in Pune: bail, age-proof issues, the Section 29 presumption, trial and appeals to the Bombay High Court.

title: Murder Case Defence
name: Murder Case Defence (Section 103 BNS / 302 IPC)
desc: Bail and Sessions trial defence in murder cases under Section 103 BNS (old Section 302 IPC), including whether the facts fall under culpable homicide (Section 105 BNS), and bail before the Sessions Court and Bombay High Court.

title: Attempt to Murder
name: Attempt to Murder Defence (Section 109 BNS / 307 IPC)
desc: Bail and trial defence in attempt to murder cases under Section 109 BNS (old Section 307 IPC), including the medical evidence, the nature of injuries and bail before the Sessions Court and Bombay High Court.

title: Kidnapping Cases
name: Kidnapping Case Defence (Sections 137, 140 BNS)
desc: Defence in kidnapping and abduction cases under Sections 137 to 140 BNS (old Sections 359 to 364A IPC), including kidnapping for ransom, with bail and anticipatory bail before the Pune Sessions Court and Bombay High Court.

title: Cheating & Fraud Cases
name: Cheating and Fraud Cases (Section 318 BNS / 420 IPC)
desc: Cheating, criminal breach of trust and property fraud cases under Sections 318 and 316 BNS (old 420 and 406 IPC): anticipatory bail, replies to police notices, FIR quashing where the dispute is civil in nature, and trial.

title: Extortion Cases
name: Extortion Case Defence (Section 308 BNS / 384 IPC)
desc: Defence in extortion cases under Section 308 BNS (old Sections 383 to 389 IPC), including cases linked to MCOCA, with bail, anticipatory bail and trial before the Pune courts and the Bombay High Court.

title: 498A / Dowry Case Defence
name: 498A and Dowry Case Defence (Section 85 BNS)
desc: Defence of husbands and family members in matrimonial cruelty and dowry cases under Sections 85 and 86 BNS (old 498A IPC): Bharosa cell counselling, anticipatory bail, FIR quashing and trial.

title: NDPS Drug Case Defence
name: NDPS Drug Case Defence
desc: Bail and trial defence in NDPS Act cases: small, intermediate and commercial quantity, Section 37 bail conditions, search and seizure compliance including Section 50, sampling and default bail.

title: MCOCA Defence
name: MCOCA Case Defence
desc: Bail, discharge and trial defence in MCOCA cases before the Special Court and the Bombay High Court, including the Section 21(4) bail test, the Section 23 approval and sanction requirements and confessions under Section 18.

title: MPID Act & EOW Cases
name: MPID Act and EOW Case Defence
desc: Defence for directors, partners, staff and agents in MPID Act, deposit-scheme and large cheating cases investigated by the Economic Offences Wing: EOW notices, anticipatory bail, bail, property attachment and trial.

title: Cyber Crime & Account Freeze
name: Cyber Crime Defence and Bank Account Freeze
desc: Defence in IT Act and online fraud cases, and help when a bank account is frozen by cyber police: understanding the freeze, applications for release before the police or Magistrate, and notices from cyber police stations.

title: Cheque Bounce Cases
name: Cheque Bounce Cases (Section 138 NI Act)
desc: Cheque bounce cases under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act in the Pune courts: legal notice, complaint or defence, settlement and appeals.

title: Criminal Appeals
name: Criminal Appeals and Suspension of Sentence
desc: Criminal appeals and revisions before the Pune Sessions Court and the Bombay High Court, and bail pending appeal (suspension of sentence) under Section 430 BNSS (old Section 389 CrPC).

title: Discharge Application
name: Discharge Application (Sections 250, 262 BNSS)
desc: Discharge applications after the charge-sheet, before charges are framed: Section 250 BNSS in Sessions cases and Section 262 BNSS in Magistrate cases (old 227 and 239 CrPC).

title: Molestation Case Defence
name: Molestation Case Defence (Section 74 BNS / 354 IPC)
desc: Defence of the accused in molestation cases under Section 74 BNS (old Section 354 IPC) and related sections: anticipatory bail, bail, FIR quashing where it applies, and trial.

title: Check FIR Online
name: How to Check an FIR Online in Maharashtra
desc: A step-by-step guide to checking and downloading an FIR on the Maharashtra Police citizen portal, what the portal does not show, and what to do if an FIR names you.
